pagerduty-bot: HIGH - dedpool node gpu-27 in auroraedge dedicated pool reporting repeated ECC parity oscillation. Auto-evict triggered (evict-id: EV-9012). Paging oncall-elena.

oncall-elena: I'm on it. Seeing ECC counters climbing and a small spike in 503s for auroraedge/vpc. Customer: AuroraEdge (enterprise VPC). Marking impact likely tenant-isolation required.

mike-sre: can you paste the quick GPU status? I'll check NVidia ECC counters and nvlink.

oncall-elena: paste: ```
GPU 27 ECC_ERRORS: correctable=124 -> 257 in 8m
GPU Temp flap: 78C -> 92C -> 76C
last kernel: "nvidia: GPU 27 ECC parity oscillation detected"
```

sam-eng: Proposal — immediate mitigation steps: 1) cordon node gpu-27 from scheduler, 2) evacuate active ae-873 sessions to warm-spare pool in same region, 3) preserve KV cache if possible (prefix-cache policy), 4) run diagnostic memtest on GPU, 5) if hardware confirmed, escalate RMA via provider. Recommend enabling traffic fallback to dedicated-fallback-1 for premium routes.

ops-bot: Started drain job djob-9012 for node gpu-27, estimated completion 15m. Evacuating 12 active sessions, rate-limit migrations to keep tail latency stable.

auroraedge-support: AuroraEdge SOC: we see ~12% error rate increase on non-VIP endpoints and some retried requests. Critical customer jobs scheduled in 3h — they ask for updates in 30m. Premium endpoints hold, so business impact limited atm.

mike-sre: cloud events show a spot-preempt hint ~6m before ECC spike: "instance preemption advisory". Could be noisy neighbor plus spot eviction causing power/thermal oscillation. Checking host BMC logs now.

oncall-elena: running cloud CLI: ```
cloudctl events get --instance gpu-27 --last 1h
# -> preempt-advisory at 14:02UTC, host-bmc-reset at 14:07UTC
```

sam-eng: Given mixed signals (thermal + preempt), conservative approach: complete drain, quarantine node, then repro on warm spare. If ECC persists post-evac, treat as hardware RMA. Notifying account manager and scheduling maintenance window if RMA required.

product-tom: Please create an SRE incident ticket and loop in AE/account team. If sustained error rate >5% for >30m, we trigger SLA review/credits. Keep a short customer-facing summary ready.

oncall-elena: Status update: drain 6/12 sessions migrated, 503 rate down to 4%, latency tail improving. Continuing migration; will cordon and set node to quarantined when done. Setting alert for repeat ECC > 300 in 10m.

ops-bot: drain complete. Node gpu-27 marked quarantined, evict job finished. Created hardware ticket RMA-4872 and attached logs: /var/log/gpu27-ecc.log. Follow-up actions: run extended GPU memtest (run-gpu-memtest --gpu 27 --duration 2h) and hold replacement if test fails.

auroraedge-support: Thanks, team. We'll notify AuroraEdge ops and ask them to delay big batch jobs for 4h. Please provide an estimated ETA for full replace.

mike-sre: If memtest fails, ETA depends on provider RMA window (24-72h). Will attempt to secure warm-spare longer term for sensitive tenants.

oncall-elena: Handoff: I'm passing to night oncall (jenny-night-oncall) at 22:00 UTC. Key notes for handoff: node quarantined, RMA-4872 open, memtest scheduled, customer notified. If ECC counters spike again, escalate to hw-rma immediately. :thumbsup:

jenny-night-oncall: acknowledged. I'll monitor the memtest results and keep AuroraEdge SOC updated.

product-tom: Please add short post-incident summary to the ticket once memtest completes. We'll follow up on SLA impacts and any credits.

ops-bot: summary: drain_success, node_quarantined, rma_ticket=RMA-4872, followups=[memtest_result, provider-RMA-schedule, customer-communication].
_meta: generated for dataset: dedicated pool GPU node failure, tenant isolation and drain/replace coordination
